description: This file contains functions and classes related to generating and caching geometric shapes for drawing elements, including shape rendering with roughjs, shape shape extraction for hit detection, and shape manipulation utilities within the Excalidraw project.

classes.name: ShapeCache
classes.description: A cache class for storing and retrieving generated shape representations of drawing elements to optimize rendering performance.

methods.name: generateElementShape
methods.description: Generates and caches a roughjs shape for a given element, regenerating if necessary, used internally by ShapeCache.

methods.name: adjustRoughness
methods.description: Adjusts the roughness parameter based on element size and type to produce visually appropriate rough shapes.

methods.name: generateRoughOptions
methods.description: Creates roughjs options for rendering an element, considering stroke style, roughness, and other visual parameters.

methods.name: modifyIframeLikeForRoughOptions
methods.description: Modifies iframe-like elements for roughjs rendering, especially when exporting or embedding.

methods.name: getArrowheadShapes
methods.description: Generates shapes for arrowheads at the start or end of a line or arrow element.

methods.name: generateLinearCollisionShape
methods.description: Creates a simplified collision shape for linear or freehand elements for hit detection.

methods.name: getElementShape
methods.description: Returns the geometric shape of an element for hit detection, used for selection and interaction.

methods.name: toggleLinePolygonState
methods.description: Toggles whether a line element is a polygon (closed shape) or not, updating its points accordingly.
